pages.text: OreSpawn joins the fashion industry: four new trim materials for every vanilla pattern, plus one pattern of our own, fished out of a $(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/vault_heist)vault$() guarded by a kraken.$(p)Endgame armor should look like where it's been. Now it can.

pages.title: How To Trim
pages.text: At a smithing table:$(p)1. Any vanilla trim template in the first slot.$(br)2. A piece of trimmable armor in the second.$(br)3. In the material slot: a $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/ruby)ruby$(), a $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/uranium)uranium ingot$(), a $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/titanium)titanium ingot$(), or a queen scale.$(p)Take out the trimmed piece. The template survives nothing; the armor survives everything.

pages.title: The Palette
pages.text: Ruby trims $(thing)crimson$(). Uranium trims $(thing)acid green$(), and no, it doesn't tick. Titanium trims cold $(thing)steel$(). Queen scale trims $(thing)orchid$() — royalty courtesy of $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/the_queen)the Queen$(), who was not consulted.$(p)One heads-up: the item sprite in your inventory shows no overlay. That's expected — put it on and the trim renders in full on the worn armor.

pages.title: The Kraken Pattern
pages.text: Our own pattern: a tentacle swirl that wraps the armor like it's being measured for dinner. The template is a $(bold)guaranteed$() find in the $(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/vault_heist)Kraken vault$() and applies with any trim material, theirs or ours.$(p)Finding it earns $(thing)Deep Sea Treasure$(); wearing it earns $(thing)Kraken Couture$().

pages.title: Duplication
pages.text: Standard template economics: seven diamonds and a prismarine block copy one template into two. The Kraken charges in prismarine because it has never once needed diamonds.
